name: N10765501 - Bolt M8x85
description:
This is a one-time-use M8x85mm Torx head bolt. It is a long torque-to-yield (TTY) or "stretch" bolt used in various applications, including securing the A/C compressor, alternator bracket, and certain areas of the oil pan, where a high and consistent clamping load is critical.
This bolt is engineered to stretch into its elastic limit upon installation to provide a secure hold that resists vibration. Once it has been torqued and subsequently removed, it is permanently elongated and weakened. Reusing the bolt can lead to it breaking, stripping the threads in the engine block, or failing to provide adequate clamping force, leading to component failure or leaks.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: N10765501

name: N91211201 - Bolt Upper Oil Pan
description:
This is a one-time-use M8x30mm Torx head bolt. As a torque-to-yield (TTY) fastener, it is commonly used for securing critical components like the engine oil cooler and sections of the oil pan where a precise and permanent clamping force is required to prevent leaks.
This bolt permanently deforms (stretches) when torqued to its final angle specification. Attempting to reuse the bolt is highly risky because it will have lost its designed elasticity and strength. This can result in an improper seal, leading to fluid leaks, or the weakened bolt could shear off during re-tightening or engine operation.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: N91211201

name: N10766301 - Bolt Belt Tensioner
description:
This is a one-time-use M8x20mm Torx head bolt. These are torque-to-yield (TTY) or "stretch" bolts commonly used to secure components like belt tensioners or the engine oil pan. Their design ensures a very specific and even clamping force is achieved when torqued correctly.
These bolts are designed to permanently stretch when tightened to specification. Reusing a bolt will result in incorrect clamping force, as it will not torque down correctly a second time. This can lead to the component coming loose, causing oil or coolant leaks, or the bolt itself can fatigue and break under stress. They must be replaced whenever they are removed.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

name: WHT007212B - Camshaft Bridge Seal
description:
This part number refers to a crucial FPM (fluoride rubber) O-ring seal, commonly used to seal the camshaft bearing bridge or cam cradle to the cylinder head. It prevents pressurised engine oil from leaking out of the camshaft bearing journals.
Due to age and constant exposure to heat, this seal can harden, flatten, and crack. A failed seal will cause a significant engine oil leak from the top of the engine, often dripping down onto the hot exhaust manifold or transmission bellhousing, which creates a distinct burning oil smell and can be a fire hazard.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: WHT007212B

name: 06K109467S - Timing Chain Tensioner
description:
This is the main timing chain tensioner. It uses hydraulic pressure from the engine oil, combined with an internal spring and mechanical ratchet system, to apply constant pressure to the timing chain guide rail. This action maintains the correct tension on the timing chain throughout the engine's operating range.
This part is notorious for failure, particularly the internal ratchet mechanism. When the ratchet fails, the tensioner can retract when the engine is off and oil pressure is absent. Upon the next start-up, the chain is momentarily slack, which can be enough for it to jump time, causing catastrophic piston-to-valve contact. A rattling noise on start-up is a critical warning sign.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 06K109467K, 06K109467P, 06K109467Q, 06H109467N, 06H109467T
short_description: This is the main timing chain tensioner. It uses hydraulic pressure from the engine oil, combined with an internal spring and mechanical ratchet system, to apply constant pressure to the timing chain guide rail. This action maintains the correct tension on the timing chain throughout the engine’s operating range.

name: 06H109469AG - Timing Chain Guide Upper
description:
This is a fixed timing chain guide rail, typically the upper guide rail that sits between the two camshaft sprockets. Its primary function is to control slack and oscillations on the top side of the timing chain, ensuring it tracks correctly between the intake and exhaust camshaft gears.
Similar to other plastic guides, this part is subject to wear from the moving chain. Failure or significant wear will result in a rattling noise from the top of the engine. If the guide breaks apart, the debris can contaminate the engine oil, and the resulting slack in the chain can lead to camshaft timing deviation faults or, in the worst case, the chain jumping time.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 06H109469AQ, 06H109469BB, 06H109469N

name: 06H109469AF - Timing Chain Guide Right Main
description:
This component is a timing chain guide rail, specifically the lower left guide for the primary timing chain. It is a fixed plastic rail that provides a smooth, low-friction surface for the timing chain to run against, preventing slack and ensuring the chain remains correctly aligned on its path between sprockets.
The plastic guide surface can wear down over time from friction with the chain. In a bad state, pieces of the plastic can break off, falling into the oil pan and potentially blocking the oil pump pickup. A worn guide will cause chain noise (slapping or rattling). Complete failure of the guide can cause the chain to lose tension and jump time, resulting in major engine damage.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 06H109469AJ, 06H109469AP

name: 06K109158M - Timing Chain
description:
This is the primary engine timing chain, responsible for synchronising the rotation of the engine's crankshaft and camshafts. This precise coordination ensures that the engine's valves open and close at the correct intervals relative to piston movement, which is essential for engine operation.
A worn or stretched timing chain is a common issue. Symptoms begin with a metallic rattling sound from the engine, especially on a cold start. If ignored, the chain can jump a tooth on the sprockets, leading to incorrect valve timing, engine misfires, a loss of power, and illumination of the check engine light. Complete failure is catastrophic, causing pistons to collide with valves.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 06K109158AA, 06K109158AD, 06K109158BE, 06K109158BS, 06H109158J, 06H109158M, 06H109158N

name: 4G0121081BT - Coolant Expansion Tank Vent Tube
description:
This is a rigid plastic engine coolant pipe, specifically the rear vent tube that connects to the expansion tank. It forms a crucial part of the cooling system's de-aeration circuit, allowing trapped air and steam to escape to the highest point of the system, the expansion tank.
Made from plastic exposed to constant high temperatures, this pipe is prone to becoming brittle and cracking, leading to sudden and significant coolant loss. Failure can cause rapid engine overheating due to the loss of coolant and the introduction of air into the system. The connection points and o-rings are common failure locations.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 4G0121081BT
short_description: This is a rigid plastic engine coolant pipe, specifically the rear vent tube that connects to the expansion tank. It forms a crucial part of the cooling system’s de-aeration circuit, allowing trapped air and steam to escape to the highest point of the system, the expansion tank.

name: 079117015P - Engine Oil Cooler
description:
This is a plate-style engine oil cooler that uses engine coolant to regulate the temperature of the engine oil. It is mounted directly to the engine block, allowing coolant and oil to pass through separate chambers within the unit to facilitate efficient heat exchange, ensuring the oil remains at its optimal viscosity.
The primary failure of this cooler is internal seal degradation, which allows engine oil and coolant to mix. This contamination creates a milky, sludge-like substance in both the cooling system and the oil sump, severely compromising lubrication and cooling. External leaks can also occur from failed gaskets, leading to loss of oil or coolant.

This is a very high quality aftermarket replacement part.

Alternate Part Numbers: 079117015P
short_description: This is a plate-style engine oil cooler that uses engine coolant to regulate the temperature of the engine oil. It is mounted directly to the engine block, allowing coolant and oil to pass through separate chambers within the unit to facilitate efficient heat exchange, ensuring the oil remains at its optimal viscosity.

name: 8K0121164R - Coolant Overflow Hose
description:
This is a coolant overflow or return hose, which connects the radiator to the coolant expansion tank. Its function is to transport expanded, hot coolant from the engine's cooling circuit to the reservoir and allow it to be drawn back into the system as the engine cools, maintaining the correct fluid level.
Over time, the rubber and plastic materials can become hard, brittle, and develop cracks, especially at the connection points. Failure typically results in coolant leaks, which can lead to a low coolant level, causing the engine to overheat. A strong smell of coolant and visible pink or purple residue around the hose are common signs of a leak.

This is an OEM equivelent part. Guaranteed quality.

Alternate Part Numbers: 8K0121164R

A clogged or dirty cabin air filter can reduce airflow from the HVAC system, leading to decreased air conditioning and heating performance, and a musty or stale odour inside the cabin. It can also exacerbate allergies for occupants.

description:
The differential pressure sensor (DPF sensor) monitors the pressure difference across the diesel particulate filter (DPF), providing crucial data to the engine control unit for DPF regeneration cycles.
A faulty differential pressure sensor can lead to incorrect DPF regeneration, causing the DPF to become clogged, reduced engine power, increased fuel consumption, and the illumination of the DPF warning light or check engine light.

description:
The high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) is responsible for pressurising fuel from the low-pressure fuel system to the extremely high pressures required by direct injection engines, ensuring precise fuel delivery.

description:

A failed exhaust manifold gasket can cause exhaust leaks, leading to a loud ticking or hissing sound from the engine bay, reduced engine performance, and increased emissions. It can also cause a strong exhaust smell inside the cabin.

Alternate Part Numbers: 06F253039F, 06F253039C, 06F253039E

name: 1K0121087E - Coolant Hose Flange
description:
The coolant hose serves as a conduit for coolant, transferring heat away from the engine to the radiator and back, maintaining optimal engine operating temperatures.
A burst, cracked, or leaking coolant hose can result in rapid coolant loss, leading to engine overheating and severe engine damage if not addressed immediately. Swelling, hardening, or visible cracks are signs of a deteriorating hose.

name: 06K115441E - Oil Filter Mount Gasket
description:
The oil filter housing seal kit contains gaskets and seals necessary to ensure a proper, leak-free seal for the oil filter housing, preventing oil leaks and maintaining oil pressure within the engine lubrication system.
A compromised oil filter housing seal kit can result in persistent oil leaks, leading to reduced oil levels, insufficient lubrication, and potential engine damage. Visible oil stains under the vehicle or around the filter housing indicate a failing seal.

name: 5K0823359D - Bonnet Strut
description:
The bonnet gas strut supports the bonnet in an open position, providing easy access to the engine bay for maintenance and inspections. It uses gas pressure to smoothly lift and hold the bonnet.
A failing bonnet gas strut will result in the bonnet not staying open on its own or falling unexpectedly, posing a safety hazard. This can be identified by the bonnet slowly closing or requiring manual support to stay open.

name: 022109423D - Engine Hydraulic Lifters (ea)
description:
The hydraulic valve lifter, also known as a hydraulic tappet or lash adjuster, is an integral component of the engine's valve train system. Its primary function is to maintain proper valve clearance automatically by compensating for wear and thermal expansion. This ensures optimal engine performance and reduces the need for manual valve adjustments.
When this component begins to fail, it typically produces a noticeable ticking or tapping noise from the engine, especially during cold starts or at idle. This sound results from excessive clearance caused by the lifter's inability to maintain contact with the valve stem. Additional symptoms of failure may include engine misfires, reduced power output, decreased fuel efficiency, and, in severe cases, increased wear on the camshaft lobes and other valve train components, which can lead to significant engine damage if left unaddressed.

This is a very high quality aftermarket replacement part.
